description: This file defines the interface for the NetworkManagerClient class, which provides methods for managing network interfaces, WiFi connections, IP settings, and related network functionalities in the NetworkManager plugin for the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies, but no implementation details.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A singleton class that provides network management functionalities such as interface configuration, WiFi management, IP settings, and WPS operations within the network plugin.

methods.name: NetworkManagerClient * getInstance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the NetworkManagerClient.

methods.name: getAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the specified interface as the primary network interface.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables the specified network interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Sets IP configuration for the specified interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the current primary network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: getInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if the specified interface is enabled.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Gets IP settings of the specified interface.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Lists SSIDs that are known (saved) on the device.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves information about the currently connected WiFi SSID.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a WiFi SSID to the known list.

methods.name: removeKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Removes a WiFi SSID from the known list.

methods.name: startWifiScan
methods.description: Initiates a WiFi network scan.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if WiFi scan was performed recently within a specified time.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information related to a network interface.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a WiFi network with provided credentials.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a stored WiFi connection by interface and ID.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves the current WiFi operational state.

methods.name: getWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Fetches signal strength and quality information for a connected WiFi network.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Initiates a WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) process.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Terminates an ongoing WPS process.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the device's hostname.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnectionsConfig
methods.description: Modifies default network connection configurations.

methods.name: wpsProcess
methods.description: Handles the WPS process logic (private method).

methods.name: getMatchingSSIDInfo
methods.description: Matches scanning SSID info with stored data (private method).

methods.name: isActiveApSameAsWps
methods.description: Checks if active AP matches WPS SSID (private method).
